_comment: Curated product data. Prices are typical Amazon or Chewy prices checked 2026-10-12; fit ranges are approximate and span the product's full size run (chest/neck girth in inches, weight in lbs). Tags drive the scoring in src/features/gear_recommender.py. links point to verified product pages.

products.name: Easy Walk No-Pull Harness
products.summary: Front-clip martingale-style harness that steers pullers sideways instead of letting them lean into the leash.

products.name: No-Pull Dog Harness
products.summary: Budget padded vest harness with front and back clips, a grab handle and reflective trim.

products.name: Freedom No-Pull Harness
products.summary: Trainer favorite: a front martingale loop tightens gently on pulls, and the velvet-lined strap prevents chafing.

products.name: Front Range Harness
products.summary: Foam-padded everyday harness with two leash points and four adjustment points for a precise fit.

products.name: Flagline Harness
products.summary: Low-profile trail harness with a handle for lifting over obstacles and a third belly strap that keeps it secure.

products.name: Web Master Harness
products.summary: Escape-resistant, five-point-adjustable harness with a sturdy handle, built for scrambling and assisted lifts.

products.name: Hi & Light Harness
products.summary: Minimal, featherweight harness that dries fast and stays cool, ideal for active dogs that don't pull.

products.name: Soft Dog Harness
products.summary: Soft mesh vest that spreads pressure across the chest; a classic choice for small dogs with delicate tracheas.

products.name: Voyager Step-In Air Dog Harness
products.summary: Step-in mesh harness: no pulling anything over the head, very breathable and inexpensive.

products.name: IDC Powerharness
products.summary: Service- and police-dog style harness with a rigid handle for close control and room for ID patches.

products.name: Tactical Dog Harness
products.summary: Heavy-duty MOLLE harness with metal buckles, a control handle and front and back leash points.

products.name: Tru-Fit Smart Harness
products.summary: Crash-tested harness with steel nesting buckles that doubles as a car restraint with the included seatbelt tether.

products.name: Journey Air Harness
products.summary: Breathable mesh harness with front and back clips; crash-tested so it works in the car too.

products.name: 3 in 1 No-Pull Harness
products.summary: Front and back clips plus a car restraint strap, with reflective trim. One harness for walks, training and the car.

products.name: Essentials Reflective Back to Basics Collar
products.summary: Simple adjustable nylon collar with reflective stitching. An easy way to carry ID tags.

products.name: Solid Nylon Dog Collar
products.summary: No-frills adjustable nylon collar, an inexpensive way to carry ID tags.

products.name: Martingale Collar with Quick Snap Buckle
products.summary: Limited-slip collar that tightens just enough to stop a dog from backing out, without choking.

products.name: Chain Reaction Collar
products.summary: Premium martingale collar with a chain cinch section, ideal for sighthounds and slip-prone dogs.

products.name: Front Range Collar
products.summary: Durable everyday buckle collar with reflective trim and a tag silencer.

products.name: Confluence Collar
products.summary: Waterproof, stink-proof coated webbing that rinses clean after swims and mud.

products.name: Gentle Leader Headcollar
products.summary: Head halter that turns the dog's head toward you when it pulls; very effective for strong pullers once introduced gradually.

products.name: Leather Two-Tone Padded Collar
products.summary: Soft, padded genuine-leather collar; needs occasional conditioning.

products.name: Tactical Dog Collar
products.summary: Wide nylon collar with a metal buckle and a built-in control handle.

products.name: Solid Nylon 6-ft Leash
products.summary: Basic 6-foot leash, available in widths from small to large dogs.

products.name: Front Range Leash
products.summary: Everyday 5-foot leash with a padded handle and reflective trim.

products.name: NEO Double Handle Traffic Leash
products.summary: Second handle near the clip gives instant close control at crossings or when meeting other dogs.

products.name: Strong Dog Leash
products.summary: Thick reflective rope leash with a comfortable padded handle for medium and large dogs.

products.name: Roamer Bungee Leash
products.summary: Stretchy bungee leash that absorbs jolts and converts to hands-free for running and hiking.

products.name: Switchbak Leash
products.summary: Two-handle trail leash that can also be worn around the waist or clipped to a tree.

products.name: Hands Free Bungee Leash
products.summary: Waist-belt running leash with a shock-absorbing bungee section.

products.name: Biothane Waterproof Leash
products.summary: Coated webbing that wipes clean and never gets waterlogged or smelly.

products.name: Check Cord Long Line
products.summary: Long training line used by bird-dog trainers for recall work in open fields.

products.name: Leather Dog Leash
products.summary: Soft, strong 6 foot leather leash that breaks in nicely. Keep it out of water and condition it now and then.

products.name: Float Coat Life Jacket
products.summary: High-visibility life jacket with a strong handle for lifting your dog back into the boat.

products.name: Granby Splash Life Jacket
products.summary: Affordable, bright life jacket with two top handles.

products.name: Swamp Cooler Cooling Vest
products.summary: Soak it, wring it out and it cools your dog by evaporation on hot days.

products.name: SpotLit LED Collar Light
products.summary: Clip-on LED light so your dog stays visible on dark mornings and in the field.
